findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_puzzle_answer" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: one_question, hub_query, check_puzzle_answer, track_info, get_trace · Public sink: submit_report, check_puzzle_answer · Destructive: track_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: one_question, hub_query, check_puzzle_answer, track_info, get_trace · Public sink: submit_report, check_puzzle_answer · Destructive: track_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
